target_input.law: SHA256-x-lift-cofactor; domain ic-paired-target-v1 NUL; little-endian u64 seed and counter; x from low 17 bits of first eight digest bytes little-endian; lift selected by digest byte 8 modulo lift count; multiply by cofactor; first nonidentity point

selection_rule: Execute and retain every arm regardless of any preceding arm's success, failure, timeout or observed cost; never substitute a new target or restart a capped run
comparison_kind: complete-pipeline-and-factor-base-policy; SAT versus F5 controls the geometric base, but incumbent uses its qualified base policy
accounting: one previously unseen public target per arm; same point and physical resource envelope; online interval starts after reusable preparation and stops immediately after independently verified scalar; retain failed attempts and separate setup diagnostics
headline_gate: Only independently audited complete one-target solves with same-point rho and calibrated conditions may enter an online-speedup ratio
registration_scope: target allocation only; exact candidate/workload manifests, source receipts and arm-specific attempt limits must be sealed separately before any paired arm execution
